item.title: Australia to launch AI safety regulator after OpenAI's breach of a government portal
item.description:
![Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese speaks about artificial intelligence during...](https://www.newsday.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.newsday.com%2Fimage-service%2Fversion%2Fc%3ANDVlODJhZWItNGY2OC00%3AYmFkODQ4MmMtNDA1Yy00%2Fcopy-of-australia-artificial-intelligence.jpeg%3Ff%3DLandscape%2B16%253A9%26w%3D1920%26q%3D1&w=3840&q=90)
Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese speaks about artificial intelligence during a press conference at Parliament House in Canberra, Tuesday, Nov.
MELBOURNE, Australia — Australia plans to create an artificial intelligence safety regulator in response to a breach of an Australian health department website by a rogue OpenAI agent in June, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said Tuesday.
“When it comes to the generational opportunity that artificial intelligence offers Australia, I’ve been very clear: our task is to make sure we shape AI rather than AI shape us,” Albanese told reporters.

item.title: Google issues ultimatum to San Diego County schools: use AI search or be cut off
item.description:
# Google issues ultimatum to San Diego County schools: use AI search or be cut off ## School districts across San Diego County must decide whether to enable Google's AI features or lose access to its search engine. #### By [Shandel Menezes](https://www.nbcsandiego.com/author/shandel-menezes/)•Published November 9, 2026•Updated on November 9, 2026 at 5:49 pm The decision comes as schools across the region grapple with how much artificial intelligence should be allowed in classrooms.
The district has taken a gradual approach to introducing artificial intelligence this school year, expanding access as students get older.
